Company Description

G R Kankate and Co. is a professional and client-focused accounting firm dedicated to providing comprehensive financial services. Known for its expertise in auditing, taxation, and financial consulting, the firm has built a reputation for delivering tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of its clients. With a commitment to integrity and excellence, G R Kankate and Co. aims to support businesses of all sizes in achieving their financial goals. Located in Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area, the firm fosters a collaborative work environment to ensure both professional growth and client success.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for a Chartered Accountant (Qualified / Semi-Qualified) located in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The selected candidate will handle day-to-day responsibilities such as preparing and reviewing financial statements, managing tax compliance, conducting audits, handling statutory filings, and offering expert financial advice. The role also includes analyzing financial data and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, while collaborating with team members and providing insights to improve financial processes and business performance.

Qualifications
• Proven expertise in accounting standards, auditing processes, and financial reporting
• Proficiency in tax compliance, including direct and indirect taxation, GST, and statutory filings
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for assessing financial data and offering actionable insights
• Proficiency in accounting software and tools, as well as Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.)
• Excellent time management, organizational, and communication skills
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
• Semi-qualified or qualified Chartered Accountant certification is required
• Experience in auditing and financial consulting is a plus
• Knowledge of the latest tax and regulatory updates will be an added advantage

About Juniper Green Energy Limited:

We are amongst the top 10 largest renewable IPPs in India in terms of total capacity* as of December 31, 2024. We develop, build, operate, and maintain projects through our in-house engineering, procurement, construction, operations & maintenance teams.

Our portfolio of projects includes wind, solar, wind-solar hybrid and firm and dispatchable renewable energy including battery energy storage systems. As of May 31, 2025, our total portfolio stands at approximately 10,069 MWp spread over 48 projects across four states in India.

Candidates with working knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics are preferred. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is an advantage. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of EY’s finance data intelligence service offering on a global scale.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Expertise on Finance functions including Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) to understand data flows, account reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.

• Support the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and data governance frameworks.
• Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring across O2C, FP&A P2P, and R2R processes.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and translate business requirements into technical data models and solutions.
• Execute data profiling, data quality assessments, and data validation using SQL, Excel, and other analytics tools.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
• Partner with project managers and cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of finance data intelligence projects.
• Apply strong accounting knowledge to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics.
• Understand financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with data accuracy and reconciliation.
• Possess technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
• Experience in Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture.
• Lead and mentor junior team members on finance data intelligence projects.
• Manage priorities effectively in a dynamic, high-pressure environment.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

• Experience in consulting or finance data intelligence roles is preferred.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with diverse audiences.
• Proficiency in English
• Adaptable and able to work in ambiguous and evolving environments.
• Collaborative team player with the ability to influence and drive consensus.
• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.

• Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.

ABOUT UNI SEOUL

Uni Seoul is India's fastest-growing Korean-inspired lifestyle brand, bringing Seoul's vibrant culture to everyday life across India. With 12 stores across Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Nashik, and Ahmedabad — and a fast-

growing D2C platform at uniseoul.in — we are building a structured business backed by marquee investors.

We're now scaling aggressively and building the internal systems that will take us from 12 to 50+ stores. The finance

function is being built from the ground up — and this is one of the earliest, most foundational hires within it.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As Accountant – Finance Operations, you will be the execution engine of our finance team. Working closely with the

Finance Lead and the founding team, your job is to ensure the books are clean, current, and audit-ready at all times.

This is not a supervisory role — it is a high-ownership, hands-on position that directly shapes how we build our financial

foundation before the function fully scales.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Bookkeeping

• Record and maintain all accounting entries across stores, channels, and entities in Tally / Zoho Books

• Handle accounts payable and receivable — timely vendor payments and collections

• Process and verify petty cash, expense claims, and store-level reimbursements

• Maintain and update asset registers, journals, and ledger schedules

Reconciliations

• Own bank reconciliations across all accounts on a daily and weekly basis

• Reconcile payment gateway settlements (Razorpay, Shiprocket, store PoS) against actual collections

• Vendor statement reconciliations — flag and resolve discrepancies proactively

• Track inter-entity and inter-store settlements with accuracy

Month-End Closures

• Prepare all base schedules and working papers required for monthly closure

• Ensure zero backlogs — every entry recorded, every reconciliation signed off before closure

• Flag exceptions, open items, and risks to the Finance Lead in advance

• Assist in preparing P&L and balance sheet schedules for management review

Compliance Support

• Compile and prepare GST workings — input/output data, GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B reconciliation support

• Assist with TDS and TCS tracking — deductions, payments, and certificate management

• Support external CAs and auditors with schedules, documents, and data requests

• Maintain documentation hygiene — invoices, contracts, challans, all organised and retrievable

Process & Data Hygiene

• Work with the Finance Lead to clean and structure historical accounting data

• Build and maintain trackers for working capital, vendor dues, and advance balances

• Flag inconsistencies or gaps in the books proactively — not reactively

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter with 2–4 years of hands-on accounting experience

• Strong working knowledge of Tally ERP or Zoho Books — able to navigate independently

• Solid understanding of GST (reconciliations, ITC, filings), TDS basics, and India accounting standards

• Prior experience in retail, e-commerce, D2C, or multi-location businesses strongly preferred

• Comfortable handling high transaction volumes without losing accuracy or pace

• Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable owning outcomes independently

• Someone who closes open items — not someone who parks them for tomorrow

WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Candidates who have only done audit / articleship and have not handled live books independently

• Those who prefer reviewing and advising over doing the actual entries

• Anyone who needs a fully structured environment before they can begin contributing

• Professionals looking for a role where reconciliations are someone else's problem

• Those who treat compliance deadlines as approximate

WHAT YOU GET

• Competitive compensation benchmarked to market

• Direct exposure to a Series A company — see how a real finance function is built from the ground up

• Close mentorship from an experienced Finance Lead and direct access to the founding team

• A clear path toward Senior Accountant or Finance Analyst as we scale to 50+ stores

• High-ownership role with real visibility — your work matters from day one

To manage Monthly, half yearly and annual Closing of Books of accounts, Reporting as per Ind AS and IFRS, co-ordinate with Statutory, Regulators and Internal Audits, submission of various regulatory returns applicable, Monitoring Internal Control systems, ICOFR and Reconciliations.

A. Preparation of financial statements

1. To prepare & Review the Balance sheet, Profit & Loss statements, and schedules under IFRS for month end closure.

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

3. To prepare financial statements as per IND AS for regulatory reporting.

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

5. Preparation of Liquidity Coverage Ratios & CRAR on monthly basis.

6. To prepare input for disclosures of various statutory financial and related information on the website of the Company on a timely manner.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

C. Audit:

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

D. Accounting Reconciliations:

1. To review the statutory remittances carried out by Taxation and HR department and provide accounting clearance and facilitate nil / insignificant open items.

2. To review the inter-co accounting and confirmation process of all the inter-companies and ensure timely reporting with nil or identified reconciliation items.

3. To review and approve the daily clearing entries.

4. To ensure closure of BRS open items related to accounting.

5. To review and approve daily WFS ( wholesale system) interface reconciliations.

6. To ensure resolution of errors in WFS batch file.

7. To recommend for accounting approvals from CAO in special cases related to accounting.

8. To prepare wholesale system reconciliation.

9. To prepare workings and raise the invoices to intercompany for various transactions.

10. Reconciliation of TDS related to dealers.

11. To prepare the dealer balances confirmation and ensure that the same is received on time in coordination with wholesale team.

E. Liaison with Shared Service Centre and Treasury Centre and other support activities:

1. To closely work with the SSC team for ensuring proper, quality and timely submission of financials with HQ.

2. To review the performance of SSC and validate the head count justification.

3. To train and educate the SSC to comply with both the IFRS and Ind AS Accounting Standards.

4. To liaison with Treasury Centre of India (TCI) for various day to day and operation topics.

5. To provide various accounting and financial related inputs to TCI for getting the Credit Rating letters.

6. To work closely with TCI in monitoring the cash flow position of the Company and facilitate them with the latest ALM and LCR submission to take meaning decisions.

7. To support other functions of the Company as and when the demand arises.

F. To automate the various manual process to ensure accuracy and increase efficiency.
